C-20.Name: Relative-path autocomplete for markdown links (matrix P1, small)
C-20.Summary: Typing a link destination — `](./doc…` — should suggest real files the way VS Code md-link autocomplete does. RECON COMPLETE (2026-09-24): image-src autocomplete already exists end-to-end (muya imageSelector popover → muya-image-picker event → ImagePathPicker float → renderer ASK_FOR_IMAGE_AUTO_PATH readdir+prefix filter, image extensions only); the missing piece is the INLINE LINK surface, which has no popover and no input hook upstream. Implementation therefore needs a muya UI plugin (LinkPathPicker, QuickInsert-pattern: input listener detects a cursor inside a link destination's parens, dispatches a muya-link-picker float) plus a generalized renderer autocomplete that accepts an extension filter (.md first; images already covered).

Problem.Description: Agent documents cross-link sibling notes; today authors must know and type exact relative paths, and typos surface only as dead links.
Problem.RootCause: Upstream Mark Text never shipped link-path completion; the image popover autocomplete is image-extension-scoped and attached to the image-selector UI only.
Problem.Evidence: docs/research/markdown-feature-matrix.md Media/Editing rows (Relative path autocomplete ❌ — P1, small). Existing machinery: src/muya/lib/ui/imageSelector/index.js:172 (calls muya option imagePathAutoComplete), ui/imagePicker (generic list+cb float via muya-image-picker event), src/renderer/src/store/editor.js ASK_FOR_IMAGE_AUTO_PATH (readdir + dir-part/prefix resolution, 50-cap, image-extension filter), editor.vue imagePathAutoComplete (icon mapping). No link-side equivalent anywhere in muya.

Goals.R-1: muya LinkPathPicker UI plugin (QuickInsert pattern): while the cursor types inside an inline-link destination `](…`, a float offers directory entries; arrow keys/Enter/Tab select, Esc hides; typing continues filtering. Dispatched via a muya-link-picker event carrying { reference, list, cb } like the image picker it mirrors.
Goals.R-2: Generalized renderer autocomplete: ASK_FOR_FILE_PATH(src, { exts }) refactors ASK_FOR_IMAGE_AUTO_PATH (same dir-part/prefix logic and 50-cap); the link flavor defaults to .md + directories; muya options gain filePathAutoComplete wired in editor.vue; the image option delegates to the same store action with image extensions (no image behavior change).
Goals.R-3: Insert semantics: completing a directory appends the separator and keeps the float open; completing a file closes it; the resulting path is inserted verbatim into the destination parens (cursor after the closing paren is NOT auto-added — muya owns the inline syntax).

Constraints.Constraint: No new dependencies; reuses BaseScrollFloat, snabbdom, and the store readdir path.
The image popover autocomplete must remain byte-identical in behavior (regression-gated by its existing coverage if any, plus new pins).
Directory traversal is READ-ONLY readdir of the current document's directory subtree — no writes, no project-wide scans (v1: current dir + typed subpaths only).

Scoped 100% coverage of the new plugin's show/filter/select logic and the generalized store action; e2e visual gate (type `](./` → float lists .md files → Enter completes); grace lint zero findings; two sequential reviews.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Workspace-wide fuzzy file search for links (quick-open already covers navigation).
Autocomplete in source-code (CodeMirror) mode — WYSIWYG first.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit: ASK_FOR_FILE_PATH resolves dir-part/prefix, filters by extension set, caps at 50, returns directories always; image path delegates unchanged (same fixtures pass for the image option).

Unit + e2e: LinkPathPicker shows on typing inside link parens, filters as the path grows, directory completion keeps it open, file completion closes it and lands the path inline; Esc dismisses; no float for image srcs (image popover unchanged) or outside link destinations.
Full suite green; grace lint zero findings on changed files; two sequential reviews clean.

AffectedAreas.M-011: editor.vue option wiring (filePathAutoComplete); editor store generalized action
